title: [smime-tree] Move mime-tree to dev-dependencies
description: Skoll MEDIUM-23: mime-tree is declared as a runtime dependency in Cargo.toml but is only used in tests (smime_tests.rs), not in any src/*.rs file. Move it to [dev-dependencies] to avoid propagating it transitively to consumers.
close_reason: Moved mime-tree from [dependencies] to [dev-dependencies] in smime-tree. It is only used in tests, not in library source.
